title_ru: ДОСПЕХИ БОГА — потеря веры, поиск, ребёнок внутри и Святая Крутость
title_en: ARMOR OF GOD — Faith Crisis, Search, the Inner Child, and Holy Coolness

patch_reason.ru: Новый слой связывает механизм Доспехов Бога с тремя существующими JANUS-артефактами: Holy Absurd/Lloyd Christmas, Dumb & Dumber/Bird Nest/Divine Child и Image of God/Protect the Child. Это уточняет, что после кризиса человек должен не убить в себе ребёнка, а освободить его от ложной нормы; взрослость затем появляется как защитная сила. Юмор должен ломать клетку ложной нормальности, а не ранить заключённого.
patch_reason.en: This patch connects the Armor of God mechanism with three existing JANUS artifacts: Holy Absurd/Lloyd Christmas, Dumb & Dumber/Bird Nest/Divine Child, and Image of God/Protect the Child. It clarifies that after crisis a person should not kill the inner child but free it from false normality; adulthood then appears as protective strength. Humor must break the cage of false normality, not wound the prisoner.

source_artifacts.role: Holy absurdity, Lloyd Christmas, good absurdity, false normality, mercy, and the rule to laugh at the cage rather than the wounded person.
Childlike innocence, love instead of greed, birds/nest as fragile peace, and the moral role of preserving wonder rather than suppressing it.
Imago Dei as protective responsibility; adult strength must make the vulnerable safer; the adult appears to protect the child within.
Separation of God from coercive false faith and movement from fear toward love.
Death of an image is not death of the Source; collapse of a false image may open space for living faith.

refined_mechanism.faith_crisis: INHERITED_IMAGE -> CRISIS -> QUESTION -> SEARCH -> TESTING -> DISCERNMENT
refined_mechanism.holy_coolness_path: ACCESS -> LAUGH -> QUESTION -> RECOGNITION -> EMOTIONAL_RELEASE -> SPIRITUAL_QUESTION -> FREE_CHOICE

holy_coolness_v1_2.intellectual_permission: You are allowed to ask why.
holy_coolness_v1_2.human_dignity: You do not need to be humiliated in order to hear a sacred question.
holy_coolness_v1_2.moral_seriousness: The joke can end; responsibility begins immediately afterward.
holy_coolness_v1_2.hope: After the old image collapses, the door home can still exist.
holy_coolness_v1_2.childlike_directness: Childlike directness means curiosity, honesty, wonder and low status-anxiety; it does not mean irresponsibility or harmful immaturity.
holy_coolness_v1_2.boundary: Holy Coolness is an access method, not a conversion guarantee.

lloyd_christmas_patch.finding: The existing JANUS Holy Absurd artifact explicitly defines Lloyd Christmas as a symbolic archetype of non-malicious absurd freedom and frames cringe as a key against false normality.
lloyd_christmas_patch.target_rule: Mock the false normality, status performance, shame trap, or pride structure — never the injured human being.
lloyd_christmas_patch.canonical_guard: Laugh at the lock, not the prisoner.
lloyd_christmas_patch.why_it_matters_for_faith: A person in religious or social crisis may already be afraid of looking foolish. Holy absurdity lowers the social cost of asking a forbidden question.

divine_child_patch.source_finding: JANUS-DUMB-DUMBER-BIRD-NEST-DIVINE-CHILD-v1.0 explicitly frames Lloyd and Harry through childlike innocence, love rather than greed, the bird nest as fragile peace, and the idea that people can lose sight of wonder when they suppress the child within.
child_mechanism: wonder survives where status anxiety relaxes
naivety may expose the absurdity of adult greed
the child is not the opposite of maturity
maturity can become the protective shell around the child

bird_nest_symbol.crow: intrusion, destruction, and the need for protection
bird_nest_symbol.observer: the witness who must learn to protect without becoming the destroyer

anti_misread: Do not treat naivety as proof of moral superiority.
Do not make children responsible for adult salvation.
Do not use innocence to erase boundaries or consequences.

image_of_god_protective_strength.source_finding: The Image of God artifact explicitly defines Imago Dei as responsibility, love, protection and accountability rather than superiority, and states that the adult should appear in order to protect the child within.
image_of_god_protective_strength.holy_coolness_interpretation: Humor frees the child; mature strength makes that freedom safe.

faith_route.sequence: old_image_breaks -> questions remain open -> answers survive testing -> living faith becomes chosen rather than inherited

departure_route.sequence: old_image_breaks -> questions remain open -> answers do not survive current testing -> honest distance from prior faith
departure_route.warning: Departure must not be defined as moral failure, and faith must not be defined as intellectual surrender.

route_comparison.research_question: Which conditions preserve curiosity, dignity, moral seriousness and hope after the inherited image of God collapses?

red_signal: the audience is isolated from alternative views
the method treats emotional impact as proof of truth
holy_coolness_diagnostics.decision_rule: If freedom decreases, Holy Coolness has failed regardless of how funny or emotionally powerful the presentation was.

child_audience_rule.goal: The method may be adapted for difficult, cynical, alienated or religiously wounded young people, but the objective is not forced conversion.
child_audience_rule.safe_goal: restore curiosity, dignity, question-permission, moral imagination, hope and access to truthful sources
child_audience_rule.forbidden_goal: exploit loneliness, fear, trauma, dependence, guilt or social pressure to obtain belief
child_audience_rule.success_metric: A young person becomes more able to ask, think, compare, love and choose honestly — whether the final branch is faith, continued search or departure.

core_thesis_update.ru: Святая Крутость работает не потому, что делает религию менее серьёзной, а потому, что делает вход в серьёзный вопрос менее страшным. После смеха человек может позволить себе спросить. После вопроса он может позволить себе увидеть. После увиденного он должен остаться свободным.
core_thesis_update.en: Holy Coolness works not by making religion less serious, but by making entry into the serious question less frightening. After laughter a person may allow themselves to ask. After asking they may allow themselves to see. After seeing, they must remain free.

canonical_lines: Смейся над замком, не над заключённым.
Ребёнка внутри не надо убивать ради взрослости — взрослость должна научиться его защищать.
Святая Крутость снижает страх спросить, но не снижает серьёзность ответа.
Смеяться над ложной нормой — да. Смеяться над раной — нет.
После кризиса мы не обязаны заранее знать, куда приведёт поиск.
Свобода вопроса должна пережить сам вопрос.
Свет не нуждается в принуждении, чтобы оставаться светом.

rules: Symbolic parallels do not establish authorial intent.
Personal testimony is evidence of lived experience, not empirical proof of supernatural causation.
A successful emotional response does not prove a theological claim.
Holy Coolness is a communication hypothesis that must remain testable and revisable.
The existence of a faith branch does not invalidate a departure branch.
